safety.note: This is a proposed-identity research register. Chronology approval and publication authorization are separate later decisions.

summary.importantQualification: Six OS 27 appearances passed independent review and are ready for chronology review; the 33 reusable iOS appearances still need evidence work. The two visionOS records are reviewed exclusions, not event candidates. No record is approved for publication or Sanity mutation.

cohorts.description: Five iOS 8.3 and 8.4 public-beta identities retained as timeline-only distribution history.
cohorts.supersessionRule: This register supersedes only the prior implication that ledger-only identities needed no further chronology review; the original batch remains authoritative for paired developer content. The reusable-evidence packet is authoritative for current identity status, evidence custody, blockers, and review state.

cohorts.description: Twenty-eight iOS 11.1 through 11.4.1 public-beta identities retained in an older local manifest but absent from production.
cohorts.supersessionRule: This register supersedes the earlier applied-state conclusion. Exact live production reconciliation controls. The reusable-evidence packet is authoritative for current identity status, evidence custody, blockers, and review state.

cohorts.description: Six macOS, watchOS, and tvOS 27 public betas plus two separately preserved visionOS do-not-create decisions.
cohorts.supersessionRule: The complete OS 27 packet supersedes the foundation's earlier three-candidate estimate and its earlier treatment of visionOS as a proposed disputed candidate.
